biotools.summary: eduomics is a Nextflow pipeline designed to simulate -omics data for educational purposes, enabling students to gain practical bioinformatics skills and interpret results within a realistic biological context. It simplifies the simulation process by automating the workflow and removing dependencies typically required by data simulation tools.
